original_test_intent: Verify the raw SMBIOS Type 13 Flags byte selects the approved abbreviated-versus-long language-string format, has no unapproved reserved bits set, is consistent with every advertised/current language identifier and persists after reboot.
original_method: Preserve the raw flags byte, decode its defined format bit and reserved positions using the applicable SMBIOS definition, validate the complete language list/current language against that selected syntax, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected flag mask, language identifier syntax and reboot plan. No BIOS language change or UI observation is inherent.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and defined/reserved bit positions
Expected abbreviated or long language-string syntax
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not change BIOS language or firmware.
Preserve the raw mask because decoded output may omit reserved bits or summarize only the defined flag.
Validate every installable/current identifier against the selected format; a correct flag with incompatible strings is not sufficient.
Do not infer UI localization availability or quality from the flag.
Stop on reserved bits, syntax inconsistency, flag drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract raw Type 13 flags, decode defined/reserved bits, validate complete language identifiers under the selected format and compare before/after reboot.
Do not modify locale, assess BIOS UI translation or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve raw mask, identifier-format expectations and reserved-bit policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, request separate UI validation if needed and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label targets the correct concept, but grep output may hide raw/reserved bits and omits the complete language list needed to prove format consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw and decoded Type 13 data, report the exact flags byte and every defined/reserved bit, then syntax-check all installable/current strings against the selected format.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 13 Flags scope, source script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw flag mask with a version-aware parser, assert reserved bits are policy-compliant and validate all indexed language strings/current reference using the advertised abbreviated or long format.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 13 BIOS Language Information implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS and parser/dmidecode versions plus locale-policy revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 13 Flags and language-string format definitions, approved BIOS language policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw/reserved-bit inspection and cross-field syntax validation to the decoded flag fragment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects masked reserved bits and format/list contradictions without claiming UI behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected mask, format and language identifiers.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The flag governs metadata encoding and does not prove interactive language switching or translation completeness.

project_override_considerations: A project may select either supported language-string format, but must provide a matching exact identifier inventory and cannot accept reserved bits merely because a decoder ignores them.
expected_evidence: Approved SMBIOS version, raw expected flags, identifier syntax and reserved-bit policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 13 data with raw/decoded flags, full indexed language list and current-language reference
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict; optional UI evidence separate

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 13 Flags field has clear encoding semantics and can be validated with its language context.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The raw mask and strings are safely parseable; missing expected policy is readiness only.

independent_technical_reasoning: The flags byte and indexed language strings are deterministic firmware data; bit and syntax checks are fully software-automatable.
